setup_wandb_logging: create a Logger instance with wandb integration for tracking training metrics and experiments
setup_metric: setup a named metric with optional grouping, cumulative tracking, and division by another metric
record_metric_value: record a metric value for the current step that will be aggregated and logged later
step_and_log_metrics: finalize current step metrics, print results, log to wandb, and reset for the next step
dist_sync_metrics: synchronize metric values across distributed processes using torch distributed all_reduce
